_test_only: TEST-ONLY public chain data: a real Ironwood-only v6 transaction mined on Zcash Testnet and its real inclusion data (txid path, block B, B's ZIP 221 leaf, path and peaks, a later header T and its auth data root), as any node serves them. No key and no note opening: crates/seam-payment's k4 module re-encrypts one of its actions to a test note with a Seam memo and re-anchors it (synthesize), which makes the synthetic payment witness the tests use.

source.copied_from: the public fields of tier2/statement/tests/fixtures/TEST-ONLY_vault9_witness.json in Zecured at 73de9f909e270e8aea10c2b221905f62a6a4c4df (a disposable test vault's deposit); its note opening, tag key and vault fields are not copied
source.checked: B's and T's hashes compared with CipherScan's Testnet API (https://api.testnet.cipherscan.app/api/block/<height>) on 2026-10-30; the txid path and the history path are checked by the crate's tests
